reviews.shade: Abib PDRN Collagen Overnight Mask Firming Jelly 80ml
reviews.text: Я не в восторге от таких ночных масок. Вообще изначально я ошиблась, думала что это маска пленка. Но ладно, наносила на лицо на ночь, но она не высыхает и не впитывается совсем, в итоге просто вытирается об полушку во время сна. В чем смысл таких масок- не понятно
reviews.zh: 我對呢類睡眠 mask 完全唔 buy。其實一開始我搞錯咗，以為係撕拉式 mask。算啦，夜晚搽上面瞓，但佢完全唔乾又唔吸收，結果瞓覺期間直接抹到枕頭度。呢類 mask 嘅意義喺邊——真係睇唔透。

reviews.shade: Abib PDRN Collagen Overnight Mask Firming Jelly 80ml
reviews.text: Love this overnight mask! The jelly texture feels lightweight and soothing, yet leaves my skin deeply hydrated and plump by morning. My skin looks smoother, firmer, and more radiant after regular use. A great addition to my nighttime skincare routine!
reviews.zh: 勁愛呢款睡眠 mask！啫喱質地感覺輕盈又舒緩，但朝早起身皮膚依然深層保濕、飽滿。持續用咗之後皮膚睇落更滑、更緊緻、更有光澤。係我晚間護膚程序嘅最佳新成員！

reviews.shade: Abib PDRN Collagen Overnight Mask Firming Jelly 80ml
reviews.text: I don’t really recommend it for an overnight mask. It’s pretty greasy and it doesn’t dry up. When you sleep all the product ends up on your pillow.
reviews.zh: 我唔太推薦當睡眠 mask 用。佢非常油笠，又唔會乾。瞓覺嘅時候所有產品都會黐到枕頭度。

reviews.shade: Abib PDRN Collagen Overnight Mask Firming Jelly 80ml
reviews.text:
It's very hydrating and you wake up the next day with moist plump skin, however it's quite sticky and takes a long time to absorb.

I'd rather wear an overnight sheet mask or a night cream, I don't think I'll buy again
reviews.zh:
保濕效果好好，第二日起身皮膚水潤飽滿，不過好黏笠，仲要好耐先吸收到。

我寧願用睡眠面膜或者晚霜，應該唔會再買。

reviews.shade: Abib PDRN Collagen Overnight Mask Firming Jelly 80ml
reviews.text: That is a good night mask and feel the skin texture after used the next day. But it's quite sticky and not absorb quickly, so it may stick on your hair or pillow when sleep.
reviews.zh: 係一款好嘅睡眠 mask，第二日用完之後可以感覺到皮膚質地變好。但係好黏笠又唔快吸收，所以瞓覺時可能會黐到頭髮或者枕頭。

reviews.shade: Abib PDRN Collagen Overnight Mask Firming Jelly 80ml
reviews.text: I use this product every night before bed. It keeps my face moisturized, and I wake up feeling great after using it. Highly recommend it!
reviews.zh: 我每晚瞓覺前都會用。佢令到我塊面保持保濕，用完之後第二朝起身感覺好好。強烈推薦！

reviews.shade: Abib PDRN Collagen Overnight Mask Firming Jelly 80ml
reviews.text: Packaging is elite, container is amazing… feels like a celebrity by mere application… snap !!! It’s awesome and feels good!
reviews.zh: 包裝係頂級，容器好正⋯⋯搽完即刻有明星嘅感覺⋯⋯「啪」一下！！勁正，感覺好好！

reviews.shade: Abib PDRN Collagen Overnight Mask Firming Jelly 80ml
reviews.text: Amazing - an absolute must have to you skin care / hair care tool kit. It is just amazing on the skin. You will love it too, I am certain. They texture, the formal - perfect
reviews.zh: 好正——絕對係你護膚／護髮工具箱必備嘅嘢。搽上面真係超正。你都會愛上佢，我肯定。佢嘅質地、配方——完美。
